text: Compute records per-pose reprojection errors for the RGB, ToF and stereo fits in the CalibrationRun, result.json and report.md, flags a pose as an outlier when its error > max(3 x median, the matching limit), report.md lists flagged poses with 'delete pose NNN and Compute again', and a failed limit caused by a flagged pose says so; hints only, no automatic pruning.

Each captured pose gets a capture-time quality hint from its RGB and ToF corner counts (e.g. 'few corners: 6 RGB - move the board closer / fill the frame'), stored in pose.json and returned by the session API.

The web_ui Calibrate page RGB-D pose list shows the capture hint and, after a Compute, each pose's RGB/ToF/stereo error with flagged poses highlighted and a one-line hint ('high error - delete and Compute again'); the existing delete-pose action stays the way to act on it.

Tests for each part (shared lib unit tests with a synthetic outlier view, node API tests, frontend tests), READMEs and tests/README.md; head_rgbd_calibration and web_ui deployed via scripts/deploy-nodes.sh.
